- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 5–10 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.67), model underestimates; adjust upward by 2–5% for next 5–10 days.  
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes; cap forecast peak at 1.5x recent 7-day high to avoid overshoot.  
- If true outcome shows mean reversion within 10–15 days after a sharp move, model should be adjusted downward by 1–3% per day until reversion completes.  
- For 30-day forecasts, model often lags by 2–4 days; add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for each lag day to compensate.  
- When sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model tends to misalign with sentiment direction; align forecast slope with sentiment trend direction.
